_notes: Model matrix for scripts/run_openrouter_matrix.py. Every run goes through OpenRouter with one OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
label becomes the results file name: results/<label>.<split>.json. slug is the OpenRouter model id.
Slugs were taken from openrouter.ai listings in September 2026; the script checks each one against the live catalogue before spending anything and skips unknown slugs.
reasoning_effort: omit for the provider default, 'none' to disable thinking where the model allows it, or minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max. GPT-6 Astra does not accept 'none'.

max_new_tokens caps the visible answer; when reasoning_effort is set the backend adds thinking headroom on top. Models that think by default (no reasoning_effort) must fit their thinking inside the cap, which is why it is 4096 rather than the CLI default of 96. It is a cap, not a target: short answers cost the same either way.

max_item_errors lets up to that many items whose call keeps failing (e.g. a provider refusing one prompt) score 0 instead of aborting the run; a systematic error still aborts after the budget. Failed items are retried when the run is resumed.
Set enabled=false to keep an entry in the file without running it.
